material_limits: All baseline evaluation portfolio stress cases contain zero positions because the qualified set is empty; zero loss is absence of exposure, not strategy robustness.
Historical evaluation data was seen in earlier research; no genuinely blind out-of-sample claim.
Synthetic minute paths and historical Binance proxy data do not establish Bitget live fill quality, liquidation behavior, outage response or profitability.
Telegram is at least once after durable enqueue and can duplicate after a crash between successful delivery and local acknowledgment.
A fill-state save followed by notification enqueue is not one atomic transaction; no exactly-once trade-alert guarantee is asserted.
Funding parser was tested with synthetic offline responses; authenticated account response compatibility remains unverified.

No assurance that all possible concurrency, propagation, manual intervention or outage scenarios are covered by tests; native initial stop and local target/time exits have distinct availability limits.
